# Morpics

> Morpics is a URL-powered image manipulation service that allows developers to transform, resize, compress, and optimize images on the fly. Simple API, type-safe SDK, edge-fast performance.

Important notes:

- Images are transformed by modifying URL parameters - no complex setup required
- Built for developers who want fast image optimization without managing servers
- Uses Cloudflare R2 for storage and global edge delivery
- Free tier available with generous limits

## Getting Started

- [Home](/): Main landing page and overview

## Key Features

- [Image Resizing](/playground): Resize images to any dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio
- [Format Conversion](/playground): Convert between WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG, and other formats
- [Image Compression](/playground): Compress images to reduce file size without quality loss
- [URL-Based Transformations](/playground): Apply transformations directly via URL parameters
- [Edge Delivery](/about-us): Global CDN delivery with Cloudflare R2

## For Developers

- [REST API](https://api.mor.pics/docs): Simple RESTful API for HTTP requests

## Technical Details

**API Endpoint:** `https://cdn.mor.pics`

**Transformation Parameters:**
- `w`, `h`: Width and height in pixels
- `fit`: Crop mode (cover, contain, fill)
- `q`: Quality (1-100)
- `f`: Output format (webp, avif, png, jpg)
- `blur`: Blur radius

**Example Usage:**
```
https://cdn.mor.pics/bucket/image.jpg?w=800&h=600&fit=crop&q=80&f=webp
```
